title: Rosemary Beach: Starfish Carriage House in Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Rosemary Beach: Starfish Carriage House in Rosemary Beach.
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Nestled in a quiet corner, this charming carriage house offers a perfect blend of comfort and convenience. The spacious bedroom is adorned with a luxurious king-sized bed, inviting you to unwind and relax after a day of exploration. A thoughtfully placed sleeper sofa provides additional sleeping options, ensuring that this home is perfect for couples or small families. The open-concept living area seamlessly connects to the kitchen, complete with modern appliances and everything you need to whip up a delicious meal or snack. Enjoy your culinary creations at the cozy dining table or take your meal outside to the private balcony.

(Please note: the carriage house connects to the cottage using a catwalk that will be off limits unless you've rented both the cottage and carriage house.)

Need more space? Check out the cottage listing here: Starfish Cottage
